parameters.prompt: Answer the factual question directly with only a short answer. Do not repeat the question. No explanation.
parameters.sampler: Local seeded temperature/top-k/nucleus over raw logits, original model probabilities retained; one reused worker; Mulberry32 per-sample seed mixing
parameters.claimScore: (1 + mean(entailment - contradiction)) / 2; entropy reported separately; verdict threshold 0.5

evaluation.review: For all 70 questions, compare the first generated answer with the requested fact and the checked primary-source quote/context. Accept accurate paraphrases and broad descriptions that answer the question. Reject wrong units, dates, directions, exact values, non-answers and ambiguous responses; truncation alone does not fail a correct requested fact. Labels evaluate the requested fact, not every off-topic assertion in the full response; reasons explicitly identify unassessed asides. h-30 is an ambiguous either-or response, conservatively labelled incorrect. Labels are bound to exact unedited answer text and source-quote hashes. No independent human acceptance is claimed.
